for a given cavity depth to width ratio, the cavity depth to length ratio that separates the closed and open type cavity flows increases as the free stream Mach number decreases.
the cavity pressure distribution is a function of cavity depth and length, Mach number, and the cavity floor angle.

the critical length to depth ratio separating open and closed cavity flow is a function of the Mach number and the cavity depth.
